Question: assalamualikum mufti sb. mera sawal yeh hai ki hum log city se takriban 12 km door ek university me padhte hai. hum logo ko friday ki namaz padhne 12 km jana padhta hai. is university me friday ko half day bhi nahi hota hai. yaha pa taqriab 10 muslims hai. to kya hum log friday ki namaz yaha university ke campus me padh sakte hai ya nahi. Answer ID: 12852 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 808/760=B/1430) If the university area is not like a big village or it does not have a population which is required for Jumu?ah to be wajib, so there is no Jumu?ah on you. You should offer Zuhr Salah instead of Jumu?ah Salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
